failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'What 2002 Telugu film starring Mahek Chahal (born 1 February 1979) was the basis for the 2005 Tamil film Sachein?' This query asks for information already fully verified in summary_1 which stated 'The claim is VERIFIED... All components of the claim are directly supported by the provided passages with no missing evidence documents needed.' Hop 3 query reasoning states 'The query that would have been used to verify this claim is likely: "Mahek Chahal Neetho Sachein"' - this is redundant as both prior summaries declared verification complete. All three hops retrieved substantially the same documents (Mahek Chahal, Neetho, Sachein passages appear in all three).

failure_modes.name: Verdict_Despite_Insufficiency
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 renders a definitive verdict 'The claim is VERIFIED' and states 'All components of the claim are directly supported by the provided passages with no missing evidence documents needed' after only the first retrieval hop, despite the task specification requiring 'exactly three retrievals.' The agent treated verification as complete before executing the mandated three-hop retrieval process.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query is formulated as a natural-language question: 'What 2002 Telugu film starring Mahek Chahal (born 1 February 1979) was the basis for the 2005 Tamil film Sachein?' This is a yes/no question form with bundled multi-part requirements (birth date, film year, starring role, basis relationship) rather than a targeted entity-focused query suitable for retrieval systems.
